availability_overrides_times_check.name: availability_overrides_times_check
availability_overrides_times_check.value: ("availability_overrides"."kind" = 'blocked' and "availability_overrides"."local_start" is null and "availability_overrides"."local_end" is null) or ("availability_overrides"."kind" = 'available' and "availability_overrides"."local_start" is not null and "availability_overrides"."local_end" is not null and "availability_overrides"."local_end" > "availability_overrides"."local_start")

availability_rules_effective_range_check.name: availability_rules_effective_range_check
availability_rules_effective_range_check.value: "availability_rules"."effective_until" is null or "availability_rules"."effective_from" is null or "availability_rules"."effective_until" >= "availability_rules"."effective_from"

calendar_notification_deliveries_anchor_.name: calendar_notification_deliveries_anchor_check
calendar_notification_deliveries_anchor_.value: "calendar_notification_deliveries"."event_id" is not null or "calendar_notification_deliveries"."invitation_id" is not null

candidate_documents_no_audio_check.name: candidate_documents_no_audio_check
candidate_documents_no_audio_check.value: "candidate_documents"."declared_media_type" not like 'audio/%' and ("candidate_documents"."detected_media_type" is null or "candidate_documents"."detected_media_type" not like 'audio/%')

candidate_links_attestation_check.name: candidate_links_attestation_check
candidate_links_attestation_check.value: "candidate_links"."policy_decision" != 'authorized_crawl' or ("candidate_links"."authorization_notice_version" is not null and "candidate_links"."authorization_attested_at" is not null)

interview_briefs_provenance_check.name: interview_briefs_provenance_check
interview_briefs_provenance_check.value:
("interview_briefs"."provider" is null and "interview_briefs"."model" is null and "interview_briefs"."prompt_version" is null)
          or ("interview_briefs"."provider" is not null and "interview_briefs"."model" is not null and "interview_briefs"."prompt_version" is not null)

interview_reports_provenance_check.name: interview_reports_provenance_check
interview_reports_provenance_check.value:
("interview_reports"."provider" is null and "interview_reports"."model" is null and "interview_reports"."prompt_version" is null)
          or ("interview_reports"."provider" is not null and "interview_reports"."model" is not null and "interview_reports"."prompt_version" is not null)

job_runs_finished_check.name: job_runs_finished_check
job_runs_finished_check.value: "job_runs"."finished_at" is null or "job_runs"."started_at" is not null
